entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Damn, that's one hell of a pig.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I doubt it's for collecting money... so why[n]is a pig decorating the entrance?
entries.uk: Сумніваюся, що вона для збирання[n]грошей... То навіщо вхід прикрашає[n]свиня?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Wait. I can feel a draft coming from[n]underneath the statue...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Doesn't this seem strange to you, Joker?
I mean, it's a weird statue.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Especially that placard. I wonder why it[n]looks so odd.
entries.uk: ...Особливо та табличка. Цікаво,[n]чому вона така дивна на вигляд.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why don't we check it out?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Let's head inside... After we're adequately[n]prepared, of course.
entries.uk: Заходьмо... Звісно, після того,[n]як належно підготуємося.
